## Route

- [ ] Fix: a test fails without this change
- [ ] Spec: `docs/specs/NNN-name/spec.md` with red acceptance tests (first PR of a feature)
- [ ] Build of an approved spec: its acceptance tests pass

## Checks

- [ ] No real recording, transcript or real person's quote is committed
- [ ] No approved acceptance test is edited
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] If a real analysis was run: its cost and what it showed
